lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [cheerful] Hi! I'm Juno. I'm eleven. And I'm a builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [proud] That's why I wear the hard hat. [pause] Builders wear hard hats. [pause] Also, I fall off my chair a lot.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Not houses. Games. For three years, I've been building my own Roblox game.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [proud, dreamy] It's called Bubble Island. Islands... inside bubbles. You float from one to the next. [pause] It's a masterpiece.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [deadpan] It has three visits.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: One is me. One is my cat. And one is Grandpa, by accident. He thought it was the weather app.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [confused, warm] Juno, why is tomorrow's weather... soap?

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: That's Grandpa Otto. He lives with us. He carries one hundred keys... and he won't tell anyone what they open.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [mysterious, whispering] Some doors... are better left closed.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [aside] He also uses a mop as a walking stick. Nobody knows why.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Mom and Dad don't play. [pause] Dad says video games rot your brain.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: And this is my best friend, Dex.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [cocky, fast] Twelve thousand hours. Every obby. Every boss. Every badge. I have NEVER fallen. Not once.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [aside, deadpan] In the game. In real life... he's scared of stairs.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [nervous] Stairs don't have checkpoints, Juno! If I fall, where do I spawn?!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [deadpan] On the floor, Dex. You spawn on the floor.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: And this is my little brother, Pip. He's six. He plays exactly one game.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [excited, tiny] Elevator Simulator!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [happy] Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: He has ridden the same elevator... forty-one thousand times. He knows every button in every elevator in the game.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [proud] Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [sighs] It's the only word he's said since Christmas.
